content: PyOD (BSD-2-Clause) v3.6.x supports multivariate detectors ECOD, COPOD, PCA, IForest via unified sklearn-style fit(X)/decision_function(X)/predict(X) API where X is 2D array (n_samples, n_features) -- no special multivariate mode needed, same classes used for univariate work in v1-v3 just accept more columns. All four are CPU-only (numpy/scipy/scikit-learn/numba deps, all BSD); no GPU needed. contamination float param (default 0.1) sets outlier threshold on decision_scores_.
